body:
I decided to give sertraline a try because I felt tired every day and had trouble feeling motivated to do work.  I'm an MD and highly functional but felt that I just needed a bit of a boost.
I started taking zoloft 50mg for 1 week, increased to 100mg for 2 weeks, then increased to 150mg for two weeks, then increased to 200mg and remained at that dose for 4 weeks.  Initially I felt subtle cognitive changes, a slight cloudiness of my sensorium but nothing impairing.  I had diarrhea for the first two weeks but it wasn't too bad.  Then by week 3 I started feeling like I had more energy.  I actually woke up feeling refreshed for the first time in a long time.  Coffee didn't really work anymore but I still drank it.  I found myself able to stay focused on reading articles for work better.  I was in a better mood in general.
Nothing drastic but noticeable to me.  I don't think anyone else noticed a change.  After another two weeks, my mood kinda dipped a little bit but remained good.
